items.title: Dark Cinematic Skin Portrait
items.prompt: Same face as reference. Same dark, obsessive aesthetic. New pose, new angle, new visual narrative. **{argument name="pose and angle" default="Pose & Angle:"}** Sharp 45° three-quarter turn. Nose crosses into the light; one eye fully illuminated, the other dissolving into shadow. Far cheekbone briefly catches light before vanishing. Shadow-side jaw disappears entirely. The angle exposes the face's underlying structure — brow ridge, nose bridge, cheekbone, jawline — as distinct planes of light and dark. **Head Tilt:** Chin lowered a few degrees, gaze lifted toward camera through the brows — heavy-lidded, intense, quietly vulnerable. Slightly raised brows add natural forehead creasing. The tilt sharpens the jaw and lengthens the neck line. **{argument name="expression" default="Expression:"}** Lips parted about 3mm — a subtle exhale, not an emotional cue. The effect should feel candid and unguarded, like a private moment caught rather than staged. **Skin Rendering:** Same forensic-level detail, applied to new areas revealed by the angle — nose wing texture in raking light, under-eye skin from a fresh perspective, lit-side jaw stubble pattern, forehead topography under top light, and partial ear detail. Neck and collarbone edge just visible at the bottom, fading into darkness. **{argument name="lighting" default="Lighting:"}** A single hard light source, positioned higher and more to the side than before, producing a narrow, surgical beam. Lit skin rendered with cold clarity; shadow side pure black. A thin blue-white rim light traces the far cheekbone. Near eye has a crisp single catchlight; far eye shows only a rim-lit iris edge and sliver of white. **Background:** Solid black, no elements — silhouette shaped purely by the new angle. **Color & Texture:** Crushed blacks, cool skin tones with warm undertone contrast, blue-white rim accent, 10% Ilford HP5 grain. Fully unretouched — pores, texture, and imperfections preserved.

items.title: Man on Luxury Yacht Staircase
items.prompt: A confident adult {argument name="subject" default="male"} stands at the center-right of the frame, facing the camera with shifted weight and level shoulders. He features a neatly trimmed dark beard with natural density variations and short, stylish brown hair. He wears an unbuttoned white linen shirt, light beige trousers, and matching suede loafers. A subtle, closed smile graces his face as his left hand is raised, with the index finger and thumb lightly gripping the frame of his dark sunglasses, his fingers curling naturally. His right hand rests relaxed inside his front right trouser pocket with the thumb visibly exposed. He is positioned in the foreground on a pristine {argument name="setting" default="luxury yacht staircase"}, featuring warm brown teak wood treads detailed with black striped rubber caulking, bordered by perfectly smooth, glossy bright white fiberglass risers, curved stainless steel handrails, and a dark tinted glass window to the right. The midground opens up on the left half to thriving, choppy ocean water, leading into a deep background featuring a dominant {argument name="background" default="suspension bridge"} with tall towers and cables spanning from the top center to the top right, alongside a mid-right cityscape of buildings clustered on rolling coastal hills. The scene is bathed in a cheerful, breezy, and aspirational late afternoon atmosphere, driven by bright, highly directional warm golden sunlight beaming from the back-left. This single natural light source provides hard light with atmospheric diffusion, creating a split-complementary palette dominated by crisp whites, ocean blues, light beiges, and warm teak. Harsh, defined gray shadows are cast forward and to the right, prominently visible on the wooden steps beneath the subject, while softer shadows beautifully wrap across his body. Intense specular highlights blow out the water surface on the left and create a strong rim light along the yacht's left edges and stainless steel handrails. This tack sharp, grain-free digital lifestyle photograph captures a realistic, clean aesthetic shot from an eye-level perspective. Emulating a full-frame camera with a 35mm or 50mm lens at f/8, a 1/500s shutter speed, and ISO 100, the deep depth of field keeps both the subject and the distant bridge in crisp focus. Post-processing enhances the high contrast, lifts the shadows on the subject's front to compensate for the backlighting, and increases the overall golden warmth while preserving the specular water reflections, all seamlessly framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.
